# JSZip

Vendored browser build of [JSZip](https://stuk.github.io/jszip/) for local multi-file PDF Split archives.

- Version: `3.10.1`
- Package: `jszip@3.10.1` from the npm registry
- npm package SHA-1: `34aee70eb18ea1faec2f589208a157d1feb091c2`
- npm package SHA-256: `5117f4a2a645aeb307bf3b829c575ad58135cc97e75291e594532ab5b5b21b23`
- `jszip.min.js` SHA-256: `acc7e41455a80765b5fd9c7ee1b8078a6d160bbbca455aeae854de65c947d59e`
- License choice: MIT; see `LICENSE.markdown`

The minified UMD build is served from this repository. Secure Tools does not load it from a CDN at runtime.
